dataset: Zenodo 15309060, all11 processed participant CSVs, CC BY 4.0
task: Source-defined hypoglycemia point classification; not continuous-time alarm evaluation
training_validation: Within each participant, first60% source rows train, next20% validation, last20% test;120 row exclusion each side of boundaries. No random window splitting.
test: Later source rows; exact timestamps absent so future chronological status remains conditional on source row order. Existing cohort used previously; exploratory.
selection: validation AP within feature set; no test-driven choice
threshold: validation Youden J with specificity >=0.8; one-class validation disables alarm; classifier scores still reported
subgroup_audit: Report all11, and same-subject metrics among hour/minute row agreement >=0.99; this does not establish absence of whole-day gaps or create timestamps.
notes: No event recall, alarm/day or prospective/clinical claims. Missing source labels are unknown. Physiological zero-coded HR/HRV/ox/respiration converted to NA. Personal early CGM labels used for training, unlike zero-shot unseen-person model.
